name: Idea Chain
description: Telephone-style: everyone writes a starter, then each round the ideas pass to the next person who transforms them. After 4 rounds, see how every chain evolved.
tagline: Great for creative thinking, brainstorming, and seeing how ideas mutate when they pass through different minds.

starterPrompt.label: Starting prompt
starterPrompt.helper: What students write at the very beginning. Each student writes one of these.

transformPrompt.label: How to transform each round
transformPrompt.helper: What students should do with someone else's idea each round. Keep it broad — same instruction is reused across all four rounds.
transformPrompt.placeholder: Keep the sentence going — add what happens next.

timer.label: Time per round (seconds)
timer.helper: How long students have to read the previous answer and add their twist.

template.name: Idea Chain: ${starterPrompt}
template.description: A 4-round telephone game built with the Idea Chain recipe.

intro.message:
🔗 Idea Chain

Everyone writes one idea to start. Then for 4 rounds, your idea passes to the next person — and you'll see someone else's idea to transform.

end.message: Look how different those endings are from the starters! 🔗✨
